known_gaps: run2 SD logs unrecoverable: the recorder truncates /sdlog/snapshot28-kmsg.log on every boot
kernel snapshot slots can never contain probe lines: the snapshotter captures the kernel console ring, and the probe writes to the logdump block device by design

pruned_payloads.reason: preboot pulls and post-clear zero readbacks are 64MiB blobs whose verdict is already recorded in the .status/.stdout files; keeping the payloads cost ~1.2GB
pruned_payloads.kept: the .stdout/.stderr/.status verdict files, every *-logdump.bin evidence pull, every kernel snapshot slot, and every SD pull

conclusion: See FINDINGS.md. The daemon probe is mechanically sound (host self-check proves it) but structurally blind: the recorder child runs outside the PID namespace Android's init uses.
open_question: The recorder's /proc tops out at ~168 entries (max pid ~168, only the ramdisk-init lineage plus kernel threads) while Android's init reports service pids 291-350 in the same boot. PID 1's mount namespace shows the same ceiling, and /proc/1/ns/pid is absent. The mechanism is still unexplained; see FINDINGS.md for the next discriminating probe.
